changes: License: a token that is missing a claim now falls back to the plan's defaults; license cache lasts 48 hours
If the network is down when the app starts, the interface keeps your plan until the license token expires instead of dropping to Free
Windows: the app reads the registry through the system API instead of launching a helper process
Veilus Flow: DSL scripts are validated when saved, not only when run
Fingerprint: device pixel ratio values are rounded to four decimals; integrated GPUs are no longer paired with large external displays
Veilus Flow canvas: every node in the palette now runs; 11 new nodes; real branches and loops; ForEach iterates over dataset rows; variables declared as {{name}} are picked up automatically
Script list: tag suggestions and filtering by tag; trash for canvas nodes; Delete key on the canvas
Local API turns on automatically when the app starts; the API & MCP page was redesigned
Profiles: macOS profiles on non-Mac machines no longer reveal the host; same-OS profiles report the machine's real GPU; MacBook Air 15 screen added
An unsigned license is treated as Free; only one app process runs at a time
Veilus runtime now bundles Node, Playwright and puppeteer-core, so scripts run without a separate install; macOS 13.5 or later
MCP server grows to 30 tools: page driving (navigate, snapshot, type, set_file…), proxy and profile creation tools, schedules, batch runs and run monitoring; a Claude Code plugin
Datasets: import TXT/CSV, assign rows to profiles, use them as variables in scripts and batch runs
Proxy pools: import and export TXT/CSV, socks5:// per line, location warnings, timezone suggested from the proxy's real exit IP
Profiles: side panel with five tabs, Notes, profile duplication, cookie copy/paste, trash for profiles and scripts, Locale and Timezone columns
Script pages: edit raw scripts in place, version history with diff and rollback, run history
Scheduling: cron with 5 fields, run once at a given time, Run Now
Fingerprint: Windows profiles work on non-Windows machines; screens, GPUs, fonts, voices and languages match real Chrome more closely; canvas and audio noise is off by default
Plans and payment inside the app: 7-day Pro trial, VND and USD checkout, renewal reminders, device limit messages
Interface: eight languages, black-and-white theme, system theme by default, new shield logo
Settings reorganised into six sections; the app can stay in the tray when the window is closed
Engine download falls back to the public URL when the signed download link cannot be issued
Engine downloads use signed links and a signed version index
Profiles: copy and paste cookies, duplicate a profile, trash
Fingerprint: WebGL renderer for macOS profiles reported the way real Chrome does; 12 new Windows GPUs; WebGPU adapter info matches the engine
WebRTC Fake IP answers only well-known public STUN servers; DNS lookups for STUN go through the proxy
macOS: cookies are protected with a dedicated entry in Keychain
First public release: profiles with their own fingerprint, storage and proxy; Veilus Flow automation; local REST API and MCP server; Veilus Sync; Windows and macOS installers
